story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Founded in 2016, Azar Bonyan Marava began with a vision to deliver world-class engineering solutions that drive progress and create lasting impact.
story.paragraph2: Through continuous innovation and the adoption of advanced technologies, we have delivered complex projects across diverse industries with excellence.
story.paragraph3: We are committed to our clients, our people, and the communities we serve — building sustainable solutions for a smarter and better future.
story.paragraph4: Our long-term vision is to be a global leader in engineering and technology, shaping a future built on innovation, integrity, and sustainability.
